events.title: Pop Up: UVA Pipelines & Pathways at VCWP Charlottesville
events.description:
Looking to Start a Career at UVA? Join Us for Upcoming Pop‑Up Events!

The UVA Pipelines & Pathways team is hosting free, in‑person Pop‑Up Events to help job seekers explore career opportunities at the University of Virginia.

Where:
Virginia Career Works – Charlottesville Center
944 Glenwood Station Lane, Suite 103
(Free parking available)

Time: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Learn about UVA Pipelines & Pathways
Get help setting up a Workday account
Apply for open UVA positions
Receive résumé support and interview tips

Walk‑ups welcome — no registration required!

Whether you’re just starting your career or looking for your next opportunity, this is a great chance to connect one‑on‑one and get personalized support.

events.title: Workforce Wednesday Virtual Job Fair
events.description:
Event is hosted by Virginia Works in partnership with the Jobs for Veterans State Grant Program every third Wednesday of the month from 10:00am – 2:00pm. All Military and Civilian Job Seekers are welcome to participate.

Our event highlights employers in the Hampton Roads area and provides employment opportunities to all job seekers, especially veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses.

Registration: Go to https://pvapi.premiervirtual.com/s/xmVgKW

Click the “Register for Event” button. On next page, Click “Register as Attendee” or “Register as Organization” button. Complete the registration section and “SAVE”. If you already have an established account, just click the sign-in button and provide your established username and password. The site will go live 5 days prior to the event start date, giving job seekers the opportunity to review company profiles and job vacancies, and upload their resumes in preparation for the event.

Possible employers include:

  • AECOM
  • BAC
  • Blueforce Inc.
  • Children’s Hospital of The King’s Daughters
  • City of Newport News – HR
  • CTR Corporation

events.title: Temp Hiring Event: UVA Transit (Charlottesville)
events.description:
🚌 UVA Transit is Hiring Temporary Bus Drivers – Paid CDL Training Available!

Looking for a career with room to grow? UVA Transit is hiring 15 Temporary Bus Drivers for temp-to-hire opportunities that may lead to full-time employment with University of Virginia benefits.

No CDL? No Problem.

UVA Transit will provide paid CDL training for qualified candidates.

💲 Starting Pay
$23.25/hour (without CDL)
$25.00/hour (with CDL)
Join Us for a Recruitment Event

📅 Thursday, November 19
⏰ 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM
📍 UVA Transit, 1101 Millmont Street, Charlottesville, VA

What to Expect

✔ Apply on-site
✔ Interview with the hiring team
✔ Tour the facility and buses
✔ Learn more about career opportunities with UVA Transit

Minimum Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent
Valid driver’s license
Good driving record
Ability to work evenings, overnights, and weekends

This event is free and open to the public.

Parking is available on the street or behind the UVA Transit facility. Please enter through the rear Operations Entrance.

Ready to get your career moving? Come meet the team and see where a position with UVA Transit can take you.

📧 Questions? Contact uvapipelines@virginia.edu

events.title: Maxim Healthcare Services Job Fair
events.description:
For this career event, we are looking for Behavior Technicians, Registered Behavior Technicians and BCBA’s to provide direct services to the autistic community.

We serve individuals from ages 2 – 22 years old. In home services, as well as daycare services such as Montessori School. A personalized service that helps build skills and replace behaviors that may interfere with quality of life. Services would likely include 1:1 sessions with the client, family guidance with the parent/legal representative, supervision by a clinician, and assessments. Treatment recommendations and specifics will be provided by the supervising clinician.
